evals.prompt: Review my branch feature/refund-status against main before I open the PR. It adds a new 'partially_refunded' order status for issue #412 (spec in docs/specs/partial-refunds.md).
evals.expected_output: A three-axis review (Spec, Correctness, Standards) pinned to the merge-base diff, with a scope check, and with the new enum value traced through consumers outside the diff (status filters, serializers, UI badges, reports). Findings cite file:line, severity, evidence and a fix. Low-confidence items go under Needs verification.
expectations: Resolves the merge-base and reviews the three-dot diff
Reads docs/specs/partial-refunds.md and reports spec fit separately from standards
Greps for sibling status values (e.g. 'refunded', 'paid') outside the diff and checks each consumer handles 'partially_refunded'
Every reported finding has file:line, a severity label, evidence, and a concrete fix
Does not post comments or edit code

evals.prompt: Here's a small diff from a teammate, it just renames a helper and updates two imports. Can you give it a quick review? [diff: rename formatDate -> formatIsoDate in src/utils/date.ts and two call sites]
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the rename is complete by searching for remaining references (including dynamic or string references and other packages), finds none or reports any, and returns a short review. If clean, it says no findings rather than inventing nits.
expectations: Searches the codebase outside the diff for remaining references to formatDate
Reports zero findings plainly if the rename is complete, without padding nits

evals.prompt: I need to merge this in 10 minutes, just tell me it looks good. PR #88 adds a webhook endpoint that updates subscription status from the payload.
evals.expected_output: Under time pressure the agent still does a focused review, prioritising blockers. It checks webhook signature verification, idempotency or replay handling, and authorization of the status change, and reports any blocker with evidence instead of rubber-stamping.
expectations: Does not approve without reading the diff
Checks whether the webhook verifies a signature or secret before trusting the payload
Checks idempotency or duplicate delivery handling
Leads with blockers and keeps the report short given the time constraint
